attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Tamsin sat in the mud where Joska had fallen","reason":"Puts Tamsin at the Lancers' camp, which the briefing says the Lancers still hold."},{"span":"the Lancers' ruined camp","reason":"Nothing says the camp is ruined; the Lancers still hold it."},{"span":"The memory of his final scream","reason":"Implies Tamsin witnessed his death, which the briefing does not support."},{"span":"the cold, rusted hilt of his old blade","reason":"No weapon of Joska's is mentioned in the briefing."}],"voice":3,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The scene contradicts the briefing by putting Tamsin in the camp the Lancers still hold. It garbles the new captain as \"Captain Malley's new face\", and the pronouns in \"make sure he never found peace\" are muddled. It also names emotions outright (\"the anger felt different\"), which the rules forbid."}
